title: Unscripted: What can software learn from improvisation?
format: Unscripted stage. No slides, no script.
abstract:
Kent Beck plays guitar. Charles Humble is half of the ambient techno duo Twofish. Between them they've also spent about sixty years building software and thinking about how it gets built.

Short loops, listening, recovering from mistakes in front of people. How big is the overlap? And what can software learn from improvisation?

This is our unscripted stage. No slides, no script, and no idea where it ends up.
